@lilitkarapetyan - I'm nervous about these changes.  I think they're too extensive.

I saw the following line. The desired behaviour was that we handed "Mark all as read" differently in COAs & RFIs.  But, the change removes that test:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/134893627-32e1dd27-3fe8-44b6-b405-5780d8be558b.png)


Sorry, but I think we need to re-start the PR.  We need to remove `RFIStatusBoard`, in one PR. Then if we need other changes they should be in another PR.
